frames.notRespondingLine: {title} has not answered for 5 seconds. Wait for it, or stop it.
frames.stoppedLine: Stopped because it was not responding. Reload brings back its last state.
frames.crashedLine: {title} stopped working and is loading again.
frames.heldLine: It stopped twice within a minute, so it stays off until you reload it. No other window is affected.
